subject: Localization Hackathon — promo code request and trial extension
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@localizely.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Localization Hackathon — request for attendee promo codes

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for speaking with me briefly at L10 last week — Localizely is running a one-day Localization Hackathon on Aug 21 aimed at developer-localization teams. We had a great turnout last year and would love to offer attendees a trial to try Redwood for model-inference tasks in their localization pipelines.

Can Redwood provide:
- 50 promo/trial codes usable by event attendees (one per person)
- Trial length: we typically ask for 90 days, but open to shorter if needed
- A small speaker allotment (5–10 codes) for judges and partners

Event page: https://www.localizely.com/localizathon-2026 (public)
We can add any promo language you prefer to our site and mailers.

If you can send a simple CSV with codes and an expiry date we can distribute them the week of the event. Happy to route legal/marketing contacts after you confirm the ask.

Best,
Alice Chen
Community & Events, Localizely, Inc.
[Attachment: localizathon_requested_codes.csv (text/csv)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@localizely.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Localization Hackathon — request for attendee promo codes

Hi Alice — great to hear from you and congrats on putting the hackathon together.

We can support event promo codes. Preliminary proposal:
- 40 attendee codes (one-use each) + 10 speaker/partner codes = 50 total
- Trial duration: 60 days by default for events; we can extend to 90 days if marketing provides a short justification (longer trials materially impact unit economics)
- Codes delivered as a CSV with columns: code, expiry_date, notes

I attached a proposed allocation CSV (proposed_allocation_soojin_v1.csv) — please confirm recipient breakdown (attendees vs speakers) and whether you need the 90-day extension. Once we have internal sign-off I'll ask Ops to mint the codes and return the export.

Also copying Marissa, Karthik and Dylan to confirm budget impact and to have code creation routed to Ops.

Thanks —
So

Sojin Lee (she/her)
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: proposed_allocation_soojin_v1.csv]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Localization Hackathon — request for attendee promo codes

Quick internal note before we finalize:
- FYI our standard event allowance for small partner meetups is up to 50 60-day trials; exceptions for 90 days require a manager+finance OK.
- If we do 90 days we should charge the partner a small co-fund or request a marketing collaboration (co-branded assets, social). Does Localizely want co-branded content?
- Karthik — can Ops create a single-use code batch with 60-day expiry and export CSV? If yes, confirm lead time (we typically need 48 hours).

Marissa
Director, Demand Gen
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@localizely.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Localization Hackathon — request for attendee promo codes

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick reply and for offering co-branding. The team approved a 50-code allocation with a 60-day trial window. Conditions:
- We will issue 40 attendee codes + 10 speaker/partner codes.
- Trial length: 60 days from code redemption.
- Codes must be used by Nov 1, 2026 (final expiry cut-off).
- Please confirm who on your side will receive the CSV for distribution (email and role).

I initiated the Ops request; Karthik will follow up with the code export and a link to the Google sheet where codes are tracked. Attachments: final allocation file and a stub for the email copy recommended for attendees.

Onboarding note: if any attendee needs an extended trial for evaluation we can review case-by-case — ask them to contact partnerships@redwood.ai.

Looking forward —
So

Sojin Lee
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: allocation_confirmation_localizathon_vfinal.csv]

Related link for tracking: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QxLocalizeHackCodes
